description: In Manager.io, open the Northwind Traders business and create a new customer with the following details: Name: Blue River Technologies, Code: BRT-001, Credit Limit: 25000, Billing Address: 1847 Innovation Drive, Austin, TX 78701, United States, Email: accounts@blueriver.tech.
